description: This file implements a version 1 log parser for a logging system, including functions for processing log messages, handling string tables, and formatting output with color coding. It defines classes for data types and the main log parser class, which extends a base LogParser class.

classes.name: DataTypes
classes.description: Class managing data types, their formats, sizes, and alignments based on target architecture and endianness.

classes.name: LogParserV1
classes.description: Main class implementing version 1 log parsing, including message processing, string extraction, and output formatting.

methods.name: get_log_level_str_color
methods.description: Converts numeric log level to string and color code.

methods.name: formalize_fmt_string
methods.description: Replaces unsupported format specifiers in format strings.

methods.name: DataTypes.__init__
methods.description: Initializes data types based on target architecture.

methods.name: DataTypes.add_data_type
methods.description: Adds a data type with its format, size, and alignment.

methods.name: DataTypes.get_sizeof
methods.description: Returns size of a data type.

methods.name: DataTypes.get_alignment
methods.description: Returns alignment of a data type.

methods.name: DataTypes.get_formatter
methods.description: Returns format string for a data type.

methods.name: LogParserV1.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the log parser with appropriate format strings based on architecture and configuration.

methods.name: LogParserV1.__get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string from the string table or formats a fallback string.

methods.name: LogParserV1.process_one_fmt_str
methods.description: Parses a format string and extracts arguments from binary data.

methods.name: LogParserV1.extract_string_table
methods.description: Extracts string table from packaged log message.

methods.name: LogParserV1.print_hexdump
methods.description: Prints a hex dump of binary data.

methods.name: LogParserV1.parse_one_normal_msg
methods.description: Parses and prints a single normal log message.

methods.name: LogParserV1.parse_log_data
methods.description: Parses binary log data and outputs formatted log messages.
